messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1m: deciding on a pragmatic design for stitching late-arriving billing/tenant attrs for cost attribution. Two options: full durable correlation ledger vs lightweight miss-capture + ephemeral mapping. Thoughts?
Diego: Ledger = easy audits & deterministic replays. Cost and ops are the tradeoffs (storage, shard mgmt).
Priya: Ephemeral mapping keeps infra simple but makes backfills and cross-region reconciliation painful. Also hard to prove historical state.
Zoe: Non-negotiable: no sync writes on ingest critical path. Any persist must be async and ack-fast. Also want compaction and TTL guarantees.
Maya: Proposal: hybrid "miss-capture ledger" — only write entries when billing attrs are absent. That should keep volume low but give us a durable trail for late-attribution.
Diego: Numbers: current sample ingest ~13k tps/region. If miss-rate ~4% -> ~520 writes/s. At ~40B compressed entry that's ~1.8GB/day before compaction. Reasonable.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: ingest snapshot (2026-03-22T02:15Z) p95=13.2k tps, p99=15.6k tps.
Priya: UX impact: analytics must support provisional vs finalized attribution. Add a "finalized_at" timestamp + "provisional" flag in cost tables.
Zoe: Ops: alerts for ledger backlog, compaction lag, reconciliation failure rate. Retention default 7d, extendable for audit windows.
Maya: Implementation sketch: (1) hot-path check for billing attrs -> skip. (2) if missing -> emit miss-event to local queue (fast). (3) async batcher writes to per-region ledger shards. (4) reconciliation worker consumes ledger, queries metadata resolver, writes final attribution to analytics and emits audit record.
Diego: Storage format: daily segment files with lightweight index (trace_id -> offset) and LZ4 blocks. Compactor dedupes repeated misses for same trace id.
Priya: Reconciliation semantics: idempotent, prefer authoritative region for duplicates, mark duplicates in audit log. Also expose drift metrics so product dashboards can show provisional vs final cost.
Maya: Action items: Diego -> prototype append writer + compaction sim. Priya -> reconciliation runner spec + analytics schema changes. Zoe -> alerting & SLOs. I'll write a short RFC addendum with owners and timeline.
Diego: I'll include a tiny kbench to simulate 12k tps bursts and measure async append tail. Target: sustain 15k writes/s with P99 append <50ms (async).
Priya: I'll add the "finalized_at" column and a migration plan for dashboards.
Zoe: Add pager rules: ledger write backlog >5m, compaction lag >1h, recon errors >0.5% -> page oncall.
Maya: Meeting Thurs 09:30 to review POC numbers. If hybrid keeps writes <5% of traces we're good to default to it. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
